speaker: charlie
text: Right, science time, and this one's close to home for us Queenslanders. Reef researchers have been trialling a biodegradable film, a bit like a sunscreen for coral, that helps shield reefs from heat stress during marine heatwaves.

speaker: alice
text: So basically we're giving the Great Barrier Reef its own version of sunnies and a hat. Early trials are promising, and it's a nice reminder that some of the smartest climate solutions are coming right out of our own backyard labs.

speaker: charlie
text: Exactly, it's not a silver bullet but every bit of breathing room helps while the bigger emissions work happens. Small science, potentially big difference for something as massive as the reef.
